query:
SELECT data, cat1 as servicos, cat2 as pacotes, cat3 as produtos, 
       (cat1+cat2+cat3) as total, lancadoPor
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug='barbiero-seraphine' AND data LIKE '2026-05%'
ORDER BY data;
